title: HERMES Shared-Stream Recovery Decision Envelope v1
description: Immutable, side-effect-free decision produced by the shared-stream recovery-authority core (design/shared_stream_recovery_contract_v1.py). INERT/DESIGN-ONLY. A future executor consumes ONLY a decision whose action == RECONNECT_AUTHORISED; every other action is advisory or throttled. WO-HELM-HERMES-SHARED-STREAM-RECOVERY-CONTRACT-DESIGN-0001.

decision_id.description: Deterministic sha256[:16] over (evaluated_at_utc, transport_state, action, sorted reasons).

evaluated_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant of evaluation, or the sentinel 'INVALID_CLOCK' when the clock guard fired.

transport_state.description: Transport-authority state machine state. Derived PURELY from transport signals, never from per-instrument freshness.

heartbeat_age_s.description: Age of last transport heartbeat/price (adapter last_tick_at). null when the heartbeat truth is unavailable -> fail closed.

shared_progress_state.description: Shared-stream progress proxy (heartbeat freshness, bumped by ANY instrument's price or a heartbeat).

expected_flow_instruments.description: Instruments governed-OPEN + past reopening grace => data expected right now.

stale_instruments.description: Non-governed-closed instruments whose data is stale past threshold (fail-loud, visible).

unvalidated_stale_instruments.description: Stale instruments lacking a validated schedule (e.g. WTICO_USD, SPX500_USD). Fail-loud health YES; transport vote NO (alone).

transport_authority.description: True only when a transport-authority condition is present (socket/provider/auth fault, confirmed shared fault, or corroborated shared-progress loss).

emergency_bypass.description: True for genuine provider/socket/auth/shared faults that must reconnect even when the application limiter is exhausted.

action.description: The single decided action. Executor obeys ONLY RECONNECT_AUTHORISED.

available.description: False models limiter store unreadable (Redis/SQL down) -> fail closed = exhausted for non-emergency authority.

config_version.description: Governed market-hours config version in force (3 on 8de293de).
